what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1978?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1978 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (184 pages) was searched for wage, payroll, salary and gross and found only the `Special Details Wages` receipt and payment lines (p40, p46), `Payroll Savings` and `Payroll Deductions` (p39, p45, p47), a payroll-service line (`ADP Payroll Service`, accountant's schedule p54), the salary lines of the accountant's schedule (p54-65) and the School Department staff counts in FTE (p175), which print no pay by person (sources/data/report-tables/1978/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1978 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1979?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1978 annual town report records only the article (p76-77, Article 3 of the April 1, 1978 Annual Town Meeting: `deleting the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on April 2, 1977 ... and substituting therefor the Classification and Salary Schedule proposed by the Personnel Board`, with two added steps for the Cemetery Superintendent, `$8,595, $9,110`) and not the schedule; searched classification, salary schedule, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1978/). — closes: the Personnel Board's Classification and Salary Schedule proposed to the April 1, 1978 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1978, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1978 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general accounts balance sheet (p48 `Revolving Funds`: School Lunch 37,062.21, School Athletics 363.34), and the School Department's own special accounts with balance on hand and spent (p178-179); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched special revenue and revolving: the hits are p48, p178-179 and a school lunch narrative (sources/data/report-tables/1978/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1978 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1978?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1978 report prints no such schedule: its balance sheet carries the `Appropriation Balances` by article as reserve lines (p47-48) and the accountant's schedule lists each article (p54-65), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project, capital plan and capital improvement: no capital plan is printed (the one `Capital Outlay` hit is a School Department line, text p15567) (sources/data/report-tables/1978/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1978 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1979?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1978 report prints the total assessed valuation (real estate and personal property) and the tax rate of $49.65 in the town facts list (p3, landed in `report-town-facts` as the rate only), the Assessors' prose on Chapter 580 and the 100 percent valuation order (p8), and the overlay only as balance-sheet lines (p48 `Overlay Reserved for Abatements`, `Reserve Fund - Overlay Surplus`); no valuation by property class, no levy or new growth schedule. Searched valuation, overlay, levy, recapitulation and new growth (sources/data/report-tables/1978/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' fiscal 1979 tax rate recapitulation (DOR form LA-5).

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1978, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1978 report prints the Inspector of Weights and Measures only as budget lines (p58 accountant's schedule, p77 the voted budget `Inspector of Weights and Measures` 870.00) and as a receipt line `Sealing Fees 290.00` (p41); no Sealer's report. Searched sealer, sealing, weights and measures across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1978/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1978 annual report to the Town.
